raw_request: Update the UI's transaction page so that the target account form item is a dropdown listing the known accounts, so users can fill out the form without having to type out a full UUID.

user_story.capability: Select a target account from a dropdown list when filling out a transaction form
user_story.benefit: Avoid having to type out a full UUID and reduce form entry errors

target_persona.permissions: Can create and manage transactions for their accounts
target_persona.context: User is filling out a transaction form and needs to specify a target account for the transaction

capability_breakdown.core_action: Select a target account from a dropdown instead of typing a UUID
inputs_required: Account identifiers (UUID, name, or display format)
outputs_expected: Selected account populated in the target account form field
Account UUID stored in the form submission
state_changes: Target account field value updated with selected account
side_effects: Form validation may trigger based on account selection

acceptance_criteria.criteria: Target account field displays as a dropdown with all known accounts listed
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user is on the transaction form, When they click the target account field, Then a dropdown list of available accounts is displayed
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Display available accounts in dropdown format

acceptance_criteria.criteria: Dropdown shows account identifiers in a user-friendly format (not raw UUID)
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the dropdown is open, When accounts are displayed, Then each account shows a readable identifier (e.g., account name or formatted display)

acceptance_criteria.criteria: Selecting an account from the dropdown populates the form field with the correct account UUID
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user selects an account from the dropdown, When the selection is made, Then the form field is populated with the account's UUID
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Store selected account UUID in form

acceptance_criteria.criteria: The dropdown is populated with all accounts available to the current user
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user opens the transaction form, When the dropdown is rendered, Then it contains all accounts the user has access to
